list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01")
  |> group(columns: ["sensor"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.sensor}))
  |> sort(columns: ["_value"])
list.definition: Sensors with actual wtvb01 data in the last 30 days

panels.title: Roll speed · detected

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01_fft")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "roll_rpm")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")

Instantaneous three-axis acceleration from the WTVB01 normal-mode registers.
panels.title: Acceleration

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.defaultBucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^acc_[xyz]_g$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + (if r._field == "acc_x_g" then "X" else if r._field == "acc_y_g" then "Y" else "Z")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "wtvb01_fft")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["sensor"] =~ /^${sensor:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] =~ /^band_z_[0-9a-z_]+_g$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.sensor + " · " + (if strings.hasSuffix(v: r._field, suffix: "_2_10_g") then "1 · 2–10 Hz" else if strings.hasSuffix(v: r._field, suffix: "_10_25_g") then "2 · 10–25 Hz" else if strings.hasSuffix(v: r._field, suffix: "_25_50_g") then "3 · 25–50 Hz" else if strings.hasSuffix(v: r._field, suffix: "_50_100_g") then "4 · 50–100 Hz" else "5 · 100 Hz–Nyquist")}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
  |> sort(columns: ["series", "_time"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["series"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
